# I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure

The good's CN code is ambiguous, so I can't select a single default SEE under the ruleset.

## Why

The ruleset selects the SEE by **CN code and country together**. The scenario gives two different CN codes for the same good:

| Source in scenario | CN code | Good | Türkiye default SEE |
|---|---|---|---|
| Product description (text) | 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.087 tCO2e/t |
| Declared line item | 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations | 2.31 tCO2e/t |

These are different goods with different default values. The rules give no way to decide which one applies, so picking either would be an estimate.

## Status of required inputs

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | **Unresolved.** It conflicts between 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. |
| (b) Country of production | Provided: Türkiye. It is listed for both candidate codes. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Provided: 1,100 t. |

## Missing input

- **A single, confirmed CN code for the good.** Either correct the line item to match the product description, or correct the description to match the line item.

Once the CN code is confirmed, the calculation is: embedded emissions = Türkiye default SEE for that code × 1,100 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
